newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Pharmacia, Cascade tumble.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Pharmacia, Cascade tumble.

text.p: Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc stock was battered in U.S. pre-open trade on Friday as investors bolted on hearing the company's forecast of disappointing results.
Preceding the opening bell, Pharmacia shares fell to 38-1/2 from its Thursday close at 41-3/8, traders said.
The company said it expects third quarter earnings per share before non-recurring charges to be near the $0.44 reported for the same period in 1995 on a pro-forma basis.
It also said fourth-quarter and full-year earnings were expected to improve from a year earlier.
